        The sample images under sofiimg/datasets/pneumonia are a subset of the
        paediatric chest X-ray collection of Guangzhou Women and Children's Medical
        Center, obtained from a public mirror released under a CC0 1.0 Universal
        public domain dedication, and resized to 224 pixel grayscale JPEG.
        
        The lung masks under sofiimg/datasets/pneumonia_masks are derived from the
        COVID-19 X-ray dataset published by v7 Labs, which released human-drawn lung
        annotations for those same films. They were rasterized and resized to match
        the images.
